<!-- pr-reviewer: 9d65c9b58c02f68a40e68fc099522b93ed0922e5 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- One rule, `wcs_slot(world, setup, params)` (`posting_wcs_slot.rs:47`), is read by `wcs_context` (generation, stamp, spindle law, machine travel, post), by the #315 rotation clause, and by both new gate clauses. I found no second copy of the inference, so no op can post through an offset other than its setup's resolved one.
- Auto (`None`) is the old inference exactly: first height-referenced slot, else G54. Every golden and fixture suite I ran is unchanged and green.
- Both refusals name the ops and setups and tell the user the fix.
  - Height on another slot than the pick: `slot_problems`, in `verification_report`, so single, script and per-op posts all see it.
  - Same word from different placements: `shared_word_problems`, in `post_script_body` only, so per-op files are exempt. Comparison uses 1 nm and q/-q tolerance, and the unplaced origin compares equal to the origin, so documents that never placed a slot are not newly refused.
- Refusing the previously silent multi-setup case is correct. One controller G54 register would run the second setup in the first one's zero, and the message points at this feature as the way out.
- The command validates at construction (missing setup, slot >= 6, same value); apply/invert write snapshots. Datum transfer copies the pick. UI queues the command only.
- v51 is justified: an old reader would post a G55 setup at G54. v50 steps up to Auto, the key is omitted when unpicked, and an unknown G-word is a corrupt file by name. Round-trip is pinned.
- Staleness is right. The stamp reads `wcs_context` only for turning kinds (`stamp.rs:123-131`, origin written only off zero). Milling toolpaths are world-space and the post subtracts the origin, so they stay fresh.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; provenance lines are present; the decision doc is in `docs/decisions/`. No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependency changes.

**Local results** (merged with origin/main, which was already up to date; no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app: setup_wcs 7, setups 11, wcs_align 5, rotated_wcs 4, posting 17, per_op_files 9, scripting 17 | pass |
| app: project_roundtrip 68, commands_undo 32, conformance 6, golden_cl 23, fanuc_post 8, probe_op 11, lathe_spindle_law 8, machine 32 | pass |
| app lib | 88 pass |
| ui lib (from crates/ui) | 285 pass, 2 ignored |
| clippy app + ui, all targets, `-D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. No test pins the staleness claim (turning op goes Stale when a pick moves its origin, milling stays Ok). It is correct by reading `stamp.rs`; a small test would protect it.
2. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is about 3770 lines. The PR adds about 23 more, so the file is already over the 400-line target and growing. The `SetSetupWorkOffset` import at line 18 is also out of alphabetical order.
3. The changelog row is for the cut. The body should keep its `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #196`, and this PR must not touch `CHANGELOG.md`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
